series.name: NitroX 3-Phase String 12–25KW (3Ph-5G) — F01–F64 + W03/W05/W13
series.notes: Inverex NITROX 12/15/20/25KW-3Ph-5G string inverters. Codes from Inverex-branded manual Table 10.1 (ManualsLib) + OEM twin Deye SUN G03/G01P3-AM8 (F36–F64 verbatim platform match). Display: LCD controller + red fault LED. PLATFORM-SPLIT warnings: F13 (string=Reserved vs hybrid=mode change), F56 (string=PV bus low vs hybrid=battery low), F58 (string=phase-U OC vs hybrid=BMS lost) — confirm model before acting. F61/F62 numbering OEM-derived where Inverex snippet incomplete (medium). Reset: DC+AC breakers off 2–5 min → on. Support: +92-21-111-209-988 / 021-32711291.
